name: Provider follow-up
description: Claims waiting on documentation or a coding answer from the provider.

name: Coding Validation Errors
description: Claims that do not pass NCCI edits or LCD/NCD coding validations.

name: Stale Claims & Timely Filing
description: Claims unadjudicated past 45 days requiring payer outreach.

name: Clearinghouse Rejections
description: EDI 277 rejections (invalid member ID, missing NPI, incorrect payer ID).

name: Payer Denials & Appeals
description: Adjudicated CARC denials requiring medical necessity appeals or redetermination.

name: Held by Customer / Clinic Action
description: Claims held by front-office request pending billing policy reviews.
